strategy.name: Opening Range Breakout (ORB 15/30 min)
strategy.summary: Trade a 5-minute close outside the first 15 or 30 minutes' range of the New York stock open, with VWAP and ATR filters.

sessions.name: Opening range
sessions.dstNote: 18:30 Pakistan time in US summer, 19:30 in US winter

rules.text: Opening range = high/low of 09:30–09:45 (15m) or 09:30–10:00 (30m) New York time.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you enter after the opening range was complete?

rules.text: Range width between 25% and 60% of Daily ATR(14); no trade if the first 15 min moved ≥ 80% of Daily ATR.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the range 25–60% of Daily ATR?

rules.text: Long: a 5m candle body closes above the range high AND price is above VWAP.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did a 5m body close above the range high, above VWAP?

rules.text: Short: mirror below the range low and below VWAP.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did a 5m body close below the range low, below VWAP?

rules.text: Stop at the range midpoint (or the opposite side if the range is tight).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop at the range midpoint?

rules.text: TP1 = 1 × range height; TP2 = 2 × range height, or exit by 11:30 New York time.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you exit by 11:30 New York time?
